mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_rule_execution (id, report_id, parse_version, rule_version, indicator_id, canonical_code, reference_rule_id, critical_rule_id, context_snapshot_json, reference_result, critical_result, applicability_result, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{reportId}, #{parseVersion}, #{ruleVersion}, #{indicatorId}, #{canonicalCode}, #{referenceRuleId}, #{criticalRuleId}, #{contextSnapshotJson}, #{referenceResult}, #{criticalResult}, #{applicabilityResult}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id AS reportId, parse_version AS parseVersion, rule_version AS ruleVersion, indicator_id AS indicatorId, canonical_code AS canonicalCode, reference_rule_id AS referenceRuleId, critical_rule_id AS criticalRuleId, context_snapshot_json AS contextSnapshotJson, reference_result AS referenceResult, critical_result AS criticalResult, applicability_result AS applicabilityResult, created_at AS createdAt FROM report_rule_execution WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id ASC
